caption:
At the start of this year, we had only 2000 followers and Alhamdulilah we’ve grown very quickly this year all the way to 30,000! We never imagined we’d make it this far let alone this quickly. We’re so grateful to all the couples who have trusted us to capture the most important days of their lives! I started film making when I was 13 years old and when I met my wife, Alhamdulilah we came together and combined our passions for cinematography and photography to create SK captures and never looked back. When we first started, we used all the money we were given at our wedding to buy our first camera together. It’s crazy looking back seeing where we are today. Over the next few years, we plan to get even bigger and better and reach even further then we already have with our quality of work. We look forward to creating more unforgettable memories with you all! Keep an eye on us over the next few years!
